** 11% chance to inflict a Crit Rate Debuff for 6-8 seconds, lowering the opponent's Critical Hit Rate by 16-40%.
* ''Passive:'' 
**Decreases the opponent's Block Proficiency against Melee Attacks by 15% per active Crit Rate Debuff.
**This bot’s naturally tough Cybertronian exterior provides a permanent 17% passive Armor Buff.
* ''Missile Critical Hit:'' Inflicts '''Burn''', dealing Heat damage for 80% Attack over 6 seconds.

===Special Attacks===

#*100% chance to Lock Special 3 for 10 seconds.
#*Inflicts a permanent -16% Crit Rate Down debuff.

===Synergy Bonuses===
* [[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Allies ''' - '''[[Bonecrusher]]'''  - +1~2~3~8% Armor.
* [[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Enemies ''' - '''[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]''' -  +1~2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* [[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Outlaws ''' - '''[[Barricade]] '''- 100% chance to inflict Power Lock for 3~6~12 seconds when hitting with the first Heavy Attack.
* [[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Forged to Serve''' - [[Megatron (ROTF)|'''Megatron (ROTF)''']] - Megatron has a 50~65~100% chance to win the fight unstoppable. Grindor receives +2~3~8% Armor.
* [[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - All lower tier teammates gain +10% Attack Rating.

==Strategy==
===Player===
Grindor is a basic Brawler bot who will deal more damage the more Power the enemy has (and amplified if awakened). Due to his high health and Special Attack denial, he can be used in very long fights. He can't gain Melee buffs, though he makes for it gaining attack bonuses against anyone with high Power. Keep in mind Power Locking is not the same as Power draining, so if an AI bot has max Power and doesn't use any Specials until the locks expire, their Power will still be there and then you're screwed.

===Opponent===
==== General ====
Grindor's tough armor, health along with Critical Rate Debuffs makes it hard to take down high-leveled Grindors. Careful evading and endurance should help in defeating him though. Grindor uses his Melee Special 1 often, so dash back from his predictable Special Attacks, then quickly counterattack. If his Sig is awakened and you have a lot of power, make sure to '''dodge his attacks!''' They deal a lot of damage, especially through Special II, and Special Attack Denial also is another reason to dodge these things.

He is a very tanky bot health-wise. Instant energy attacks, damage over time and powerful Armor Breakers (even more so when the Armor Break can be permanent) will be your friend, as Grindor has no answer to these. 

Even more so when he is on a Security Module, or an [[Utility Module]] which grants him more Armor, like the one in [[Rulers of Kaon]], in which he becomes ''absolutely impervious''.

==== Rulers of Kaon ====
As stated above, unless you have an anti-armor bot or abilities that bypass defensive buffs like Dark Burns, Grindor becomes near-invincible and cannot be hurt regularly. However, if you have abilities that can get around that, Grindor turns out to be one of the easier fights in Rulers of Kaon. Just prepare for a long fight as Grindor's massive health pool will take a long time to drain.

===Strong Match-ups===
==== Bots ====
* Anyone with power rate buffs will feel the force of Grindor’s perforation damage and before they will know it and they will have their specials disabled.
*Bots with strong specials like [[Mixmaster]] will have no chance at all from using the specials 2 and 3.
*[[Hot Rod]] generates a lot more Power because of his signature ability. Grindor gets stronger the more Power the opponent gets, enabling him to deal a lot of damage.
* [[Arcee]] will be prone to Grindor's Perforation and Crit Rate Debuffs.
* [[Kickback]]’s dinner relies on Critical Hits, and Grindor serves Crit Rate Debuffs. 
==== Mods ====
*[[Robot Resource]] - Defenders gaining a lot of Power through this Module will feel the full force of Grindor's Peforation Damage and he can disable the opponent to use even the special 3 when having full power.

===Weak Match-ups===
==== Bots ====
* Anyone who Armor Breaks and Armor Pierces will put Grindor to sleep easily.
* [[Galvatron]], [[Megatronus]] and [[Megatron (ROTF)]] deal pretty strong energy damage, which will ignore Grindor's tough armor.
** Megatronus in particular also has an Armor Break and gains power very slowly, and Grindor won't be able to make full usage of Peforate. Though he can disable Megatronus' Special Attacks.
* [[Dinobot]]’s particular skillset make him adept at cutting through the armor of this thick-skinned helicopter.
* [[Megatron]] will ensure Grindor never toughens up.
* [[Grimlock]]’s burn debuffs and devastating specials will ignore Grindor’s tough armor.

==== Mods ====

===Recommended Modules===
Turn Grindor into a flying tank with these Modules!
* The [[Security Module]] will ensure Grindor always toughens up.
* The [[Repair Module]] will keep Grindor in battle for longer periods.
